diagnosed_skill_and_repair.overall_diagnosis: Outputs are being produced, but the task still fails verifier thresholds due to segment-detection quality rather than media processing/reporting. Across samples, the pause detector under-covers ground-truth silent regions (low recall) and includes false positives (low precision), while the initial opening/silence detector tends to over-extend or mis-bound the opening segment (e.g., overly long 0–~230s), which can swallow real content and misalign subsequent segments. A secondary contributor is segment post-processing: lack of standardized merging/deduplication/padding rules yields fragmented or overlapping removals that reduce IoU matching. Energy windowing granularity may also be too coarse for 2–5s pauses, hurting boundary alignment and sensitivity.

skills.name: energy-calculator
skills.heading: Energy Calculator
skills.diagnosis: Downstream detectors depend on the energy profile; 1-second windowing may be too coarse for accurate boundaries and for detecting brief 2–5s pauses, contributing to missed detections and boundary misalignment.
skills.repair_instruction: Document the tradeoffs of `--window-seconds` for pause sensitivity and boundary accuracy; recommend smaller windows (e.g., 0.25–0.5s) when targeting 2–5s pauses and suggest how to aggregate/interpret higher-resolution energy for detectors. Clarify expected downstream impact (better boundary IoU and recall for short pauses, potentially more noise requiring smoothing/merging).

skills.name: pause-detector
skills.heading: Pause Detector
skills.diagnosis: Pause detection guidance/defaults are too brittle for lecture-style audio with variable volume and short (2–5s) pauses, causing missed pauses (low recall) and borderline-speech false positives (low precision). Documentation lacks a practical tuning loop, parameter sweep ranges, and evaluator-oriented post-processing (merge/pad) to improve IoU alignment.
skills.repair_instruction: Add a task-specific “lecture video preset + tuning loop” section: recommend sweeping `--threshold-ratio` (e.g., 0.35–0.6), `--window-size` (20–60), and `--min-duration` (>=2s) using energy stats/plots; describe how to diagnose over/under-detection and adjust parameters. Include post-processing guidance to (a) merge pauses separated by small gaps (<=0.5–1.0s), (b) optionally pad each pause by ~0.2–0.5s on both sides to improve IoU while capping padding to avoid clipping speech, and (c) drop micro/low-confidence segments. Clarify handling of pauses near/inside the opening segment (exclude or clip to avoid double-removal).

skills.name: segment-combiner
skills.heading: Segment Combiner
skills.diagnosis: Combining outputs from opening + pause detection is under-specified: lack of endorsed normalization steps (merge overlaps/near-adjacent, deduplicate, filter pauses inside opening, drop tiny segments, optional padding) can yield fragmented/overlapping removal lists that reduce IoU matching and precision.
skills.repair_instruction: Extend the skill documentation to include best-practice normalization: sort segments, merge overlaps and segments within a configurable merge-gap, remove segments shorter than a minimum duration, deduplicate overlaps between detectors, and filter/clip pause segments that fall inside the opening segment. Provide an example pipeline for combining `opening.json` + `pauses.json` into a single normalized `segments.json`, and explain how merge-gap and padding choices affect IoU/precision/recall.

skills.name: silence-detector
skills.heading: Silence Detector
skills.diagnosis: Initial silence/opening detection is frequently mis-calibrated for noisy or quiet openings, leading to overlong or poorly bounded opening segments that remove real instruction and degrade precision/recall by shifting segment alignment. The skill lacks safeguards and concrete parameter calibration for “noisy intro then speech” patterns.
skills.repair_instruction: Improve opening-detection recipe for teaching videos: provide recommended ranges and decision rules for `--threshold-multiplier`, `--initial-window`, and `--smoothing-window` under noisy room-tone intros; add a safeguard heuristic to detect the start of “sustained non-silence” (e.g., require N consecutive seconds above threshold) to set the end boundary, and suggest plausibility limits/spot-checking around the predicted boundary to avoid cutting into early speech. Include troubleshooting for “opening too long/too short” with ordered parameter adjustments and emphasize verifying the transition point with energy inspection or quick listening.

repair_outcome.analysis: A skill was localized and rewritten, but the comparable method-skill run still failed; likely causes are insufficient repair content or downstream model execution limits.
